warnings.message: CONTRAINDICATION: Ibuprofen interacts with Warfarin (current medication). Risk of severe bleeding.
warnings.details: NSAIDs like Ibuprofen significantly increase bleeding risk when combined with anticoagulants like Warfarin. This combination can lead to gastrointestinal bleeding and other serious hemorrhagic events.

alternatives.rationale: No interaction with Warfarin. Safe for pain relief and fever reduction.
Minimal systemic absorption. Lower bleeding risk compared to oral NSAIDs.
